overview_description.description:
Energy demand is skyrocketing, and renewable energy is the most scalable path forward. But today’s development process can’t move fast enough to meet global goals.

Paces exists to change that. We are building AI agents, software and services to accelerate power and data center deployment and lower costs - unlocking one of the greatest opportunities of our time: transforming how infrastructure gets built and ensuring it’s built with renewable energy.

Paces automates early-stage due diligence and provides the expertise to accelerate late-stage diligence, fast-tracking projects from siting to construction-ready. Our platform supports renewable energy and data center developers, real estate firms, and more by streamlining siting, interconnection, and permitting. With Paces, teams can de-risk decisions, shorten timelines, and get more renewable energy projects built.

product.name: Paces Software Platform
product.description: An integrated software platform for siting and developing clean energy projects with built-in grid, permitting, and environmental data.

product.name: Paces Modular Services
product.description: Flexible services for site screening, permitting, and power analysis that integrate with development workflows to support project advancement.

product.name: Accelerated Development Framework (ADF)
product.description: A development approach that uses AI-driven site vetting, pre-vetted locations, and integrated workflows to reduce risk and accelerate clean energy project timelines.

product.name: Environmental Reports
product.description: Automated reports consolidating environmental, zoning, and permitting data to support faster site screening for renewable energy projects.

product.name: Fractional Development Services (FDS)
product.description: On-demand expert services addressing permitting, interconnection, and environmental reporting to help developers overcome project bottlenecks.
